documents.title: Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Notice of Postal Ballot
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

analysis.summary: Mayur Uniquoters reported a 20% standalone revenue growth for Q1 FY27, driven primarily by price realization rather than volume. Management expects a 10% to 15% top-line growth over the next three years, supported by strong export momentum despite current volatility. The company is currently evaluating international expansion options to de-risk operations and meet customer requirements. Management remains committed to maintaining sustainable margins of 25% plus 1-2%. Mayur Uniquoters reported strong financial performance for FY26, driven by export growth and improved operating efficiency.

guidance.claim: Management targets sustainable margins of 25% plus 1% or 2%.
guidance.quote: No. This margin is -- actually, we told you earlier also in our previous con call that margin -- sustainable margin will be 25 plus 1% or 2%.

guidance.claim: Management targets an average 15% growth in value for the coming years.
guidance.quote: So we have kept potential outlook for 15% growth in the coming year also.

demand_outlook.claim: Export business is expected to grow significantly over the next three years.
demand_outlook.quote: Sir we have already told that our US business will increase and next in next three years the business will almost be if not double at least 60%, 70% our US business will increase, right?

demand_outlook.claim: The company is experiencing strong export demand but faces muted growth in the domestic footwear segment.
demand_outlook.quote: So obviously, the market was muted in the footwear segment.

demand_outlook.claim: Export growth momentum is expected to continue for the next 2-3 years.
demand_outlook.quote: And this increased momentum is expected to continue in the next 2-3 years.

demand_outlook.claim: The company is focusing on higher-value items rather than low-priced products.
demand_outlook.quote: And in the domestic industry also, what type of business that we are targeting, we are not targeting a very low-priced item. We are targeting a much more higher-value items.

demand_outlook.claim: The company notes that the European automotive industry is not growing and is experiencing a story of degrowth.
demand_outlook.quote: But if you see, European automotive industry is not growing as much rather than it's -- there is a story of degrowth over there.

demand_outlook.claim: Management states that the footwear business is not growing due to local competition and low price margins.
demand_outlook.quote: Our Footwear business is not growing because of local competition, because of price -- low price margin.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has ordered a new production line for its existing facility, expected to be operational by February or March 2027.
capex_expansion.quote: so we have already ordered the line for our expansion in our current premises. So we should be able to start our production by -- towards the end of this financial year, somewhere between February, March 2027.

capex_expansion.claim: Management is evaluating potential greenfield expansion outside India.
capex_expansion.quote: We definitely need to put more plants somewhere outside India. But because of all this Trump tariff, the West Asia war or multiple things happening in the last few years, we have not taken a final call where -- which should be the ideal location to put our plant.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is installing a new coating line at an existing facility with an investment of approximately INR 50 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: In India, we have ordered a coating line. But instead of putting it in South India, we have found space in an existing facility only. So, we will put it here. So, our capacity will increase. But we are not putting it in South India. We are putting it here.

capex_expansion.claim: Management is evaluating capex of approximately INR 200 crores for a plant in South India or approximately INR 300 crores on a global scale.
capex_expansion.quote: So if we are evaluating which one we have to go for first. But if we do in South, it's approximately INR200 crores. If we do on a global scale, it will be INR300 crores over there.

capex_expansion.claim: The South plant would start with 500,000 millimeters per month initially and take approximately two years to start once a decision is taken.
capex_expansion.quote: So once the decision is taken, it takes approximately 2 years for the plant to start. And we will start with 500,000 millimetres per month initially.

margins_costs.claim: Recent margin moderation was attributed to increased freight costs and raw material price volatility.
margins_costs.quote: Majorly because of this freight increase and remaining is some service providers cost and this troubling and risk coverage cost. That is.

margins_costs.claim: Operating efficiency improvements and export mix contributed to margin expansion.
margins_costs.quote: So, our OE, I told in the previous question also, our operating efficiency also improved. That is one reason. Second reason, our export mix also increased.

margins_costs.claim: Raw material prices have softened from March highs and availability is not an issue.
margins_costs.quote: And prices have also softened a little bit from the highs of March. It's softened a little bit. But availability is not an issue right now.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that import of raw materials accounts for nearly 1/3 of total raw material cost.
margins_costs.quote: Normally, imports are nearly 1/3 of our total raw material cost.

margins_costs.claim: Plasticizer and yarn prices have started going up.
margins_costs.quote: In fact, plasticizers prices have started going up. Yarn prices have started going up.

margins_costs.claim: Other income in the quarter included foreign exchange gain of around 50% with the remainder coming from treasury income.
margins_costs.quote: This quarter, other income has the major part of foreign exchange gain around 50% and remaining is our treasury income.

orders_capacity.claim: Current capacity utilization is between 75% and 78%.
orders_capacity.quote: So, we are utilizing somewhere between 75% to 78%.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has received new OEM supply orders from the U.S.A.
orders_capacity.quote: And in this context, we have received some good OEM supply orders from U.S.A., which have already started making good contribution to our export sales revenue and overall business profitability.

orders_capacity.claim: The company sold 31 million meters of product in FY26.
The new coating line is expected to increase revenue by INR 120-150 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: So, revenue will increase by INR 120 Cr. – INR 150 Cr.

orders_capacity.claim: Total volume for the quarter was 76.3 lakh meters, including PU volume of 2.56 lakh meters.
orders_capacity.quote: Total volume has been 76.3 lakh meters, including PU, which has been 2.56 lakh meters for the quarter and value 6.17.

orders_capacity.claim: The South plant infrastructure will be built to make 1 million millimeters per month.
orders_capacity.quote: So, the infrastructure will be ready, but the line will be added into...

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical tensions and shipping disruptions are cited as key risks impacting operations.
risks_headwinds.quote: See what is happening in the world since the last years. Covid has come. Ukraine war. Okay, then there was the West Asia war. Shipping lines disturbance has become very high.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical situations and war have impacted freight costs and export dispatches.
risks_headwinds.quote: Our freight cost has gone down in this quarter because of this war situation and all

risks_headwinds.claim: Short-term margin pressure may occur due to the time lag in passing on raw material price increases to customers.
risks_headwinds.quote: Short-term, yes, maybe a month or so. Because it takes some time to pass on the price increase to the customers. Definitely, it impacts a little bit in the short-term.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that cheap imports are coming from China along with a lot of manipulation.
risks_headwinds.quote: A lot of cheap imports are coming from China. There's a lot of manipulation.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to start production from the new expansion line by the end of the current financial year.
management_commitments.quote: So we should be able to start our production by -- towards the end of this financial year, somewhere between February, March 2027.

management_commitments.claim: Management projects top-line growth of 10% to 15% over the next three years.
management_commitments.quote: So, we have already said that you can expect a top line growth of between 10% to 12% for the next 3 years.

management_commitments.claim: The new coating line is expected to be commissioned by the end of the calendar year.
management_commitments.quote: So, by the end of this calendar year, it should be done.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects export order momentum and contribution to top line and bottom line to continue in the next 2 to 3 years.
management_commitments.quote: And this increased momentum is expected to continue in the next 2, 3 years.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
